note: The root key records the place name’s consonants. Its historical derivation is uncertain.
summary: Admah is a city on the Canaanite boundary. Genesis names it alongside Gomorrah and Zeboiim and identifies Shinab as its king.

senses.definition: The city listed between Gomorrah and Zeboiim in the description of Canaanite territory.

evidence.note: The boundary description names Admah in the sequence “Sodom and Gomorrah and Admah and Zeboiim.”
Shinab bears the title מֶלֶךְ אַדְמָה, “king of Admah.”

senses.gloss: Admah, a city on the Canaanite boundary
